lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Wednesday's Planning and Zoning meeting, where the Town's own Carhenge Redevelopment Project — a lot consolidation and concept review at 700 W Pacific Ave — goes before the commission for the first time. The same day, SMART's board takes up two vendor-contract votes tied directly to the gondola structural analysis, which means the bridge-or-bust question on that project moves another step. Town Council also convenes a special session Sunday to hold a public hearing on KOTO Radio's Live at the Drive liquor permit.

notable.stake: Town-owned Carhenge site faces subdivision and concept review votes.
Two gondola structural-analysis contracts up for binding board votes.
